name: lysine methyltransferase 2D
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: KMT2D encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2D. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Kabuki syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant); choanal atresia-athelia-hypothyroidism-delayed puberty-short stature syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Follicular lymphoma; Marginal zone lymphoma; Adamantinoma of long bones. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: KMT2D encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2D. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Kabuki syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant); choanal atresia-athelia-hypothyroidism-delayed puberty-short stature syndrome (autosomal dominant).
